text:
alex: Hi team, alex here. Fresh laptop (Pop!_OS 22.04). Trying to run the repo bootstrap but asdf node/python installs fail and bootstrap.sh aborts because it can't find direnv and a .envrc. Also brew install stalls on some post-install script. Any quick pointers?

Dana: welcome! For Pop!_OS (Ubuntu-derived) treat it like Ubuntu: install `build-essential`, `libssl-dev`, `zlib1g-dev`, `libreadline-dev`, `pkg-config`. That usually fixes asdf builds for python/node.

Tom: for brew on linux the installer wants you to add brew to PATH; if it "stalls" watch the terminal for the prompt where it asks to add lines to `~/.profile`. Run the installer non-interactively if needed and then `eval $(/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/brew shellenv)`.

alex: I installed the deps and brew, but `asdf install nodejs 18.16.0` still fails with `gyp ERR! stack Error: Can't find OpenSSL`. I did `sudo apt install libssl-dev` already.

Dana: try installing `openssl@1.1` via brew and export flags before asdf build: `brew install openssl@1.1` then `export LDFLAGS="-L$(brew --prefix openssl@1.1)/lib"` and `export CPPFLAGS="-I$(brew --prefix openssl@1.1)/include"` then `asdf install`. Also make sure `pkg-config` is installed.

alex: nice, that worked for node. For python `asdf install 3.11.4` complained about `readline`. I added `libreadline-dev` and `ncurses-dev` but still saw errors.

Tom: the package on Debian/Ubuntu is `libncurses5-dev` or `libncurses-dev` depending on distro. Also ensure `xz-utils` and `libbz2-dev` are present. I usually run `sudo apt install -y build-essential libssl-dev libbz2-dev libreadline-dev libsqlite3-dev zlib1g-dev xz-utils libncurses-dev pkg-config` and then retry.

alex: thanks, python build succeeded after that. Quick question about `.envrc`: bootstrap.sh expects direnv and a `.envrc` referencing `.env.local`, but I don't have secrets yet. Should I create a stub `.env.local`?

maya: yes, copy `env.example` to `.env.local` and put placeholder values for the keys you don't have. Create a minimal `.envrc` like `export $(cat .env.local | xargs)` then run `direnv allow`. We use 1Password for secrets; infra will provision access.

infra-bot: [onboarding] created ticket ONB-712 for Alex to get 1Password and repo access.

alex: perfect. Last thing: dotfiles bootstrap asks for SSH key; can infra push a key if I want to avoid generating a new one?

maya: we prefer you generate your own keypair and add the public key to your account. If you really need infra to push a key, open the ticket and mark it temporary.

alex: thanks everyone 44d. I'll document the steps I used in case other Pop!_OS folks join. Appreciate the help!
